verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a localhost API with a published OpenAPI spec for querying, retrieving and updating objects, plus an official MCP server and an agents skill that lets AI assistants read, search and modify Objects. A headless CLI server mode means agents can do this without the GUI. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent read/write in headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent or assistant can read AND write my notes headlessly — through a documented local API, vendor API, or MCP server — without me touching the GUI

citations.quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.
The Anytype MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.
gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects in your Anytype Channels
Learn how to query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build powerful extensions.
Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost.
